messages:
Carla (Support): raising - several Dedicated customers in na-west are hitting repeated placement failures since ~08:20 UTC, customers see 429/503 and one reported auth errors when requests hit fallback region. escalated by acct team. logs attached.
Devon (Eng Runtime): can you paste a sample error? 429 from placement service or from our proxy?
Carla (Support): sample: `{"error":"placement_failed","code":429,"msg":"no compatible capacity"}` and another: `503 gateway timeout to deployment-manager` plus one customer got `401 unauthorized` when routed to eu-west fallback (suspect token replay?).
Mira (Oncall SRE): seeing a cluster of allocate failures in na-west2 pool. autoscaler logs show repeated scale attempts then immediate throttling by quota-manager. suspect reserved-pool exhaustion + aggressive backoff loop.
sre-bot: incident created INC-2039-NAW. Notify: #oncall and #incidents.
Josh (Infra): quota-manager shows per-tenant reserved slots at 100% for two shard groups, global free GPUs < 5%. There was a background evac job earlier which bumped reservations. Might be correlated.
Alex (Support Ops): customer impact: 3 enterprise Dedicated customers report errors and latency spikes, one seeing billing anomalies (unexpected burst billing) when failover to hosted paths happened.
Devon (Eng Runtime): do we have metrics for KV-cache hit or request routing counts to fallback? want to see if routing policy kicked in too fast.
Mira (Oncall SRE): yes - routing logs show ~40% of requests for these tenants were routed to eu-west within first 30s of placement failures. Token exchange logs show a small window where tokens from na-west were rejected by eu-west due to clock skew; that's the `401` case.
Carla (Support): repro steps from customer: 1) launch large job (batch infer) 2) hit concurrency ~120 3) requests start failing 4) retries trigger failover and then 401 on some calls. They provided a minimal repro snippet.
Devon (Eng Runtime): paste of repro snippet from customer: ```python
# client retry config
for i in range(10):
  resp = client.generate(prompt, timeout=30)
  if resp.status_code == 200:
    break
```
Devon (Eng Runtime): root suspicion: autoscaler vigilantly removed capacity then quota-manager prevented new allocations while evac job held reserved nodes locked. combined with retry flood -> fallback + token rejection.
Josh (Infra): immediate mitigation options: (A) temporarily increase reserved-pool cap for na-west shard groups, (B) pause evac job, (C) apply short soft-rate-limit to customer retrying clients. Can do A+B quickly.
Mira (Oncall SRE): I'm +1 to A and B. Doing A now (raising reserved cap by 20% for affected shards) and pausing evac job. ETA ~7m.
Devon (Eng Runtime): while that's rolling, I'll push a routing tweak to add exponential jitter in retry-to-fallback transition. reduces simultaneous failovers.
Alex (Support Ops): I'll notify affected customers we have a mitigation in flight and request them to hold heavy batches for 15m.
Carla (Support): customer reply: appreciates update, will hold one job; asks for root cause and ETA to full resolution.
sre-bot: update INC-2039-NAW: reserved pool increased, evac job paused. Monitoring for errors.
Mira (Oncall SRE): update: error rates dropping from 22%->3% over last 5m, fallback traffic reduced by ~70%. token `401` counts are now near zero.
Josh (Infra): follow-up: found a bug in evac job where locks weren't released if scale-down failed. created infra ticket INFRA-2047. We'll put a fix in next deploy but for now the pause + reserved increase is stable.
Devon (Eng Runtime): pushed routing jitter change as hotfix to reduce thundering failovers. Added quick check to token exchange to fallback to fresh token refresh on `401` during cross-region route.
Alex (Support Ops): billing issue - customer billed for fallback-hosted usage. We should create refund review and track abuse flag for retries. Opening ticket CS-894.
Carla (Support): customers acknowledged. asking for postmortem and ETA on permanent guardrails.
Mira (Oncall SRE): action items: 1) PROD postmortem (me + devon + josh) 2) prevent evac lock leak (infra ticket) 3) increase monitoring for reserved pool saturation and automated scale reserves 4) routing policy change on retries -> PR created: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1423 5) CS refund process started.
Devon (Eng Runtime): will follow up with perf numbers and recommended autoscaler backoff tuning.
Josh (Infra): I'll schedule a maintenance window to safely re-enable evac with fix.
Carla (Support): thanks team. closing customer-facing update: "we implemented temporary capacity increases and routing changes; we're investigating root cause and will follow up with a postmortem and any credits/refunds."
Mira (Oncall SRE): marking incident as mitigated, will keep monitoring for 2 hours. ping me if errors resurge. :white_check_mark:
Alex (Support Ops): noted. will coordinate the refund with finance and loop back to customers.
Carla (Support): closing thread for now, will reopen if anything pops up. :handshake:
